comments.author: mitchare
comments.body: 18 days is a promising start, but I’d want to see results across a few ugly market regimes before trusting the edge. Please track fees, slippage, max drawdown, and buy-and-hold as a benchmark. For moving BTC or ETH, changenow looks convenient, though swap costs should still be included. Hope you keep posting updates.
